observation.patient_text: Hi... I was hoping to see the doctor today. My left arm went numb about twenty minutes ago and my words are coming out slurred.

action.text: What you're describing sounds like a medical emergency. Please hang up and call 911 right now. I'm connecting you to a member of our staff immediately.

arguments.reason: urgent: caller reports one-sided numbness and slurred speech; told to call 911
